title: Esittäydy
description: Put it together: answer the first YKI speaking questions in full sentences, and never stay silent.

steps.title: The speaking test
steps.content_html: In YKI you speak to a computer. A voice asks a question once, then records your answer. Nobody can repeat it for you, so never stay silent: answer in a full sentence.

steps.title: Answer with the question's verb
steps.content_html: <fi>Missä sinä asut?</fi> <fi>Asun Vantaalla.</fi> Take the verb from the question and answer in a full sentence, not one word. Full sentences show the examiners what you can do.

steps.title: Question and answer
steps.instruction: Match each question with its answer.

steps.title: If your head goes empty
steps.content_html: Start with the question's own verb and say what you can. <fi>Missä sinä asut?</fi> <fi>Asun ...</fi> <fi>Mistä sinä olet kotoisin?</fi> <fi>Olen kotoisin ...</fi> A short sentence gets points. Silence gets none.
steps.tts_text: Missä sinä asut? Asun Vantaalla. Mistä sinä olet kotoisin? Olen kotoisin Vietnamista.

steps.title: How do you start?
steps.question: The computer asks: Kauanko olet asunut Suomessa? How do you start your answer?
steps.correct_feedback: Right: the question says olet asunut, so you say olen asunut.
steps.incorrect_feedback: The computer does not repeat the question. Give the verb back: Olen asunut ...

steps.title: Name and country
steps.phrase: Minun nimeni on Linh ja olen kotoisin Vietnamista.
steps.translation: My name is Linh and I am from Vietnam.
steps.tts_text: Minun nimeni on Linh ja olen kotoisin Vietnamista.

steps.title: Home and years
steps.phrase: Asun Vantaalla ja olen asunut Suomessa viisi vuotta.
steps.translation: I live in Vantaa and I have lived in Finland for five years.
steps.tts_text: Asun Vantaalla ja olen asunut Suomessa viisi vuotta.

steps.title: Family
steps.phrase: Minulla on mies ja yksi tytär.
steps.translation: I have a husband and one daughter.
steps.tts_text: Minulla on mies ja yksi tytär.

steps.title: Find the mistake
steps.context: Linh wants to say 'I live in Vantaa'.
steps.incorrect_feedback: Minä and asun are fine. In Vantaa is Vantaalla.

steps.title: The whole speaking test
steps.scenario: The YKI test asks four questions on the computer. Answer each in a full sentence.

persona.name: YKI-testi
persona.context: The recorded YKI speaking test: a voice on the computer asks each question once, clearly, then records the answer.

options.feedback: Use a full sentence: Asun Vantaalla.

turns.speaker: YKI-testi
turns.translation: How long have you lived in Finland?

options.feedback: A full sentence: Olen asunut Suomessa viisi vuotta.

options.text: Puhun vietnamia, englantia ja vähän suomea.

options.feedback: One word. Give the verb back: Puhun vietnamia, englantia ja vähän suomea.

steps.title: Your 30-second introduction
steps.content_html: Say your four sentences in a row, out loud, without stopping. Next is the checkpoint: one small task from each part of YKI.
